resources.string: Read from a physical Quran or elsewhere? Record your planner pages here, then continue from the next unread page.
Use the page numbers in this planner (604-page Madani numbering).
%1$s per page · based on %2$d measured pages in your planners
No measured page average yet. Enter your time below; a personal estimate becomes available after you finish pages with the in-app timer.
Set a different time for each page
%1$d pages already read will be skipped. Their time will not be added again.
Continue from page %1$d in your planner.
This finishes your plan. Your reading will be saved in its history.
Enter a valid page range from 1 to 604.
Every page in the range must belong to this planner.
These pages are already recorded. Choose unread pages.
Choose a reading date today or earlier.
Enter a positive time for each page (seconds 0–59), with no more than 24 hours total.
This planner changed or is no longer active. Go back and open it again.
Could not finish saving. Please try again; a saved entry will not be counted twice.
Estimated time contributes to your totals and stays separate from measured reading.
Starts at your current page, %1$d. You can log up to page %2$d in this planner.
Enter a positive page count or a last page from your current page up to the end of this planner.
Your planner reading position changed. Go back and reopen this form to use the current page.
